text:
Ari: Heads-up \/ visiting Melbourne CBD on Thursday, landing midday. Anyone know a good laneway brunch near Federation Square for ~1pm? Prefer a mix of veg + strong coffee.
Bea: Hardware Lane has tonnes of spots. For brunch vibes try Topiary on Hardware Lane ":coffee:" — great coffee and decent veg options.
Connor: If you want full Aussie brunch with GF options, Pilgrim Bar & Bistro on Flinders Ln is cosy.
Dina: Chapel Street Cafe (tiny but excellent avocado smash) is a bit further but walkable if you like a quieter spot.
Ethan: For a bigger group, Supergrain (near Fed Sq) does all-day brunch and can handle dietary prefs.
Fiona: Quick poll: react with :one: Topiary  :two: Pilgrim  :three: Chapel St  :four: Supergrain
Bea: :one:
Connor: :two:
Dina: :three:
Ethan: :four:
Ari: Supergrain sounds safest for a group of 6. Fiona, can you check if they can do 1:00pm Thu and note GF + one vegan?
Fiona: Calling Supergrain now...
Fiona: Supergrain can take a booking Thu 1:00pm for 6. Conf SG-334. They can do GF toast and a vegan scrambled tofu on request. They asked to note any nut allergies.
Fiona: Reservation details:
```
Supergrain Brunch & Co
Federation Square precinct
Thu 1:00pm 1 party of 6
Conf: SG-334
Notes: GF toast + vegan scrambled tofu available; flag nut allergy in comments
```
Ari: Brilliant, thanks Fiona! Added to calendar.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar "Thu Melbourne: Supergrain 1:00pm"
Connor: I'll meet from the office, might be 5-10 min late.
Dina: I'll bring the list of allergies to add to the reservation comments.
Ari: Appreciate it everyone — see you Thursday! :sunny:
